svg.text: Rate limits hook: the proxy's limiter on the proxy's shared counters
Scopes, in the proxy's order
api_key: key rpm/tpm (else budget row's),
max_parallel_requests
user, team, team_member (team:user)
end_user: its budget row, or the default
read with the key; end users cached 60 s
no limits set: no Redis call at all
Three Redis scripts, in the proxy's phases
1. requests: +1 on every {scope:id}:requests in one call, fixed window from the first hit;
over when count > limit; the count is never given back
2. in flight (key only): ZSET of slots on Redis TIME, pruned at 3600 s, full at limit
3. tokens: reserve chars/4 + output x candidates on every scope, all or none;
output = max_tokens, else the configured estimate, else max(input, min(1024, tpm/4));
a limit under 4096 caps an uncapped request at that floor upstream
Refusal: 429, first scope over
"Rate limit exceeded for api_key: <hash>. Limit type: requests.
Current limit: 10, Remaining: 0. Limit resets at: ... UTC"
chat: throttling_error + retry-after, rate_limit_type, reset_at
messages: Anthropic rate_limit_error envelope, no retry headers
a refused token reservation gives its slot back
Admitted: request runs
complete responses carry where each limit stands:
x-ratelimit-{scope}-remaining-{type}, -limit-{type}
every response: x-litellm-key-rpm-limit / -tpm-limit
streams get no x-ratelimit-* headers, as in the proxy
Settle (off the request path)
tokens: INCRBYFLOAT (actual - reserved) on each reserved scope, actual = all tokens but cache reads; a failure returns the reservation
in flight: ZREM the request's slot when the response ends, fails, or the client goes away
Same keys, scripts and windows as the Python proxy, under its namespace
ns:{api_key:<hash>}:window | requests | tokens | max_parallel_requests: gateway replicas and Python proxies enforce one limit.
No Redis, or Redis unreachable: the same logic on this replica's counters (fail_closed_rate_limit_enforcement: 503 instead)
